PSC REF#:392217 Public Service Commission of Wisconsin RECEIVED: 06/17/2020 2:53:40 PM June 17, 2020 Ms. Steffany Powell Coker Secretary to the Commission Public Service Commission of Wisconsin Post Office Box 7854 Madison, WI 53707-7854. Wisconsin Electric Power Company is the applicant and owns the Concord Generating Station. Concord Generating Station, located in the City of Watertown, Jefferson County, Wisconsin, consists of four natural gas simple cycle combustion turbine units of 100 MW each. The estimated cost of the project is $24,300,000 for the four units. The four Concord units could be retired in 2022 if the overhauls are not approved. Unit 1 and 2 work would begin in September 2021 and be completed by May 2022. The overhauled Unit 1 will be placed in service in May 2022. A certificate of service was mailed to every party on the service list on June 17, 2020. The ambient sound survey was completed August 12 through 14, 2025 at three measurement points near the site. Critical facilities are not located in the 100-year flood plain of any river. Notice of Investigation was issued on July 28, 2020 to open this docket in 2020.
